The sheriff's star is a separate Scatter: three of these symbols anywhere award a payout without needing to form a line.
wazdan-fruit-fiesta.editorial: The Scatter is not described as a Free Spins trigger here: it directly pays for matches anywhere on the screen. Free spins should not be added simply because Scatters work differently in other slots.

features.title: Pepper Wild
features.description: Substitutes for other regular symbols, helping to form a winning combination across the twenty lines.

features.title: Star Scatter
features.description: Three or more Scatters pay regardless of lines.

features.title: Piñata Gamble
features.description: After a win, a piñata can be chosen in an attempt to double the prize already awarded.

intro: Sun of Egypt combines 25 lines with a three-respin Hold & Win.
Bonus symbols lock in Hold & Win, while Free Spins can retrigger.
3-oaks-gaming-sun-of-egypt.editorial: Bonus symbols lock in Hold & Win, while Free Spins can retrigger.

features.title: Six Suns trigger Hold & Win
features.description: In the original Sun of Egypt, six Bonus Suns open three respins. Symbols stay locked, and a new Sun resets the counter to three.

features.title: The first game's jackpots
features.description: Fixed Mini and Major jackpots appear in Hold & Win; filling all fifteen positions can award the Grand Jackpot worth x1000 the bet.

features.title: Scatter Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger Free Spins containing only high-paying symbols. Another three Scatters during the feature add ten spins.

intro: Three or more Rascal symbols trigger Rascal Respins: they become Sticky, new Rascals extend the sequence, and filled groups can merge into Colossal symbols.

The Pendulum alternates between Coin and Wild modes and determines the final transformation of all Rascals: in Coin Mode they become Coins/Colossal Coins, while in Wild Mode they turn into Wilds/Colossal Wilds and award an additional spin.
hacksaw-gaming-red-rascal.editorial: Red Rascal makes the outcome of a respin sequence depend both on the number of Rascals collected and on the Pendulum's current position. The same filled grid can therefore end with either a money phase or a Wild phase.

features.title: Rascal Respins and Colossal Symbols
features.description: Three or more Rascal Symbols lock and trigger Respins. New Rascals can extend the sequence, while adjacent characters merge into larger Colossal Rascals occupying several cells.

features.title: Pendulum Coin Mode and Wild Mode
features.description: The Pendulum alternates the Respins outcome mode: Coin Mode turns Rascals into Coins and Colossal Coins, while Wild Mode creates Wilds and Colossal Wilds and starts an additional spin.

features.title: Ready to Riot, After Dark, Ignite the Night
features.description: Three FS open eight Ready to Riot Spins with frequent Rascals; four award ten After Dark spins with collection of inactive Rascals. Five FS trigger Ignite the Night with at least four Rascals and a Pendulum switch on every spin.

intro: A Poker Chip symbol on the third reel triggers Lightning Blaze. Neon Frames appear on the grid, turning positions inside them into high-paying symbols and creating a separate layer of progression within the spin.

The official page separately describes two scatter features on reels 2–4: Fortune Roll reveals an Instant Prize up to x200 the total bet, while Crystal Free Spins award 8 spins on a taller grid. Crystal symbols in Free Spins add sticky Neon Frames, which all turn into the same high-paying symbol on the final spin.
playn-go-crystal-hall.editorial: Crystal Hall builds its base-game special mechanic around Neon Frames, while the bonus round keeps those positions until the final ignition. The two officially described scatter scenarios should remain distinct: Fortune Roll handles an instant prize; Crystal Free Spins provides an expanded grid and accumulated Frames.

features.title: Lightning Blaze
features.description: A Poker Chip on the third reel triggers Neon Frames that can turn positions into high-paying symbols.

features.title: Fortune Roll
features.description: One of the separate Scatter mechanics awards an Instant Prize up to x200 the total bet.

features.title: Crystal Free Spins
features.description: Eight spins take place on an expanded grid; sticky Neon Frames remain until the final transformation.

intro: Fruit Mania differs from Fruit Fiesta through nine independent reels and a Diamond Bonus matrix: a full table opens nine Bonus Spins.
Diamonds appearing in the bonus lock until the sequence ends. Lotto Bonus, by contrast, is triggered by three lottery symbols on the three middle reels.
wazdan-fruit-mania.editorial: Sharing the word Fruit in their titles does not mean the games share mechanics: this game has Diamond Bonus and Lotto Bonus, rather than Fruit Fiesta's Wild pepper and Scatter star.

features.title: Nine Diamond Bonus Spins
features.description: A table completely filled with diamonds awards nine bonus spins; new diamonds lock until the round ends.

features.title: Block Symbols Mode
features.description: Locking symbols on the grid allows them to count in subsequent spins.

features.title: Lotto Bonus in the centre
features.description: Three Lotto symbols on the three middle reels open a choice of one of three prize tickets.

intro: Six Bonus Symbols trigger Hold & Win with three respins.
New Bonus Symbols lock and reset the counter to three, while a Mystery Symbol can reveal a jackpot.
3-oaks-gaming-sun-of-egypt-2.editorial: The round's main distinction is the Mystery Symbol within Hold & Win, adding a separate outcome to the collection of locked Bonus Symbols.

features.title: Hold & Win from six Suns
features.description: In the second instalment, six Bonus Symbols start three respins. Every new symbol locks and restores the counter to three, following the series' basic structure.

features.title: Mystery and Grand x5000
features.description: A Mystery Symbol can reveal a fixed Mini, Minor or Major; filling the whole grid gives a chance at the Grand Jackpot worth x5000 the bet, rather than the original's x1000.

features.title: Eight Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters open eight Free Spins with low-paying symbols removed. Three additional Scatters can retrigger the bonus.

intro: Tribute symbols carry adding or multiplying values and form a LootLine when they occupy a winning payline. Their values combine sequentially from left to right, and the result is multiplied by the bet.

In This Is Rome, non-winning Tribute symbols from a spin with a Tribute win are saved in the LootBar according to their reels. Once five LootBar positions are filled, their values pay under the same rules as a LootLine.
hacksaw-gaming-reign-of-rome.editorial: Reign of Rome turns a payline into an arithmetic sequence: Tribute symbol order matters because adding and multiplying operations apply from left to right. The bonus LootBar separately saves unused Tributes and later combines them into an additional LootLine.

features.title: Tribute LootLines and arithmetic
features.description: Adding and Multiplying Tribute Symbols form a LootLine along a winning line. Values are calculated in sequence from left to right, so addition and multiplication depend on each Tribute's position.

features.title: Path to Power and stronger Tributes
features.description: Three FS open ten Path to Power Spins, with high-value Tribute Symbols landing more frequently. Additional FS during the bonus can increase the number of remaining spins.

features.title: This Is Rome and LootBar
features.description: In This Is Rome, unused Tribute Symbols after a win are saved in the LootBar according to their reels. Five collected values form a separate payout calculated with LootLine arithmetic.

intro: Crystal Sun uses 10 fixed paylines paying combinations in both directions: left to right and right to left. An Expanding Wild appears on reels 2–4 and carries an x1, x2 or x3 multiplier.
Every Expanding Wild automatically expands and triggers a re-spin. Re-spins continue while new Wilds appear on the reels; the multipliers of all Wilds participating in a winning payline add together.
playn-go-crystal-sun.editorial: Crystal Sun makes re-spins depend entirely on repeated Expanding Wild appearances: no separate scatter trigger is required for the sequence. Its defining feature is additive Wild multipliers, which sum on a winning line rather than multiplying together.

features.title: Two-way lines
features.description: Ten fixed lines pay both left to right and right to left.

features.title: Expanding Wild
features.description: A Wild on reels 2–4 expands across the entire reel and triggers a re-spin.

features.title: Adding multipliers
features.description: The Wild carries x1, x2 or x3; multipliers on a winning line add rather than multiply.

intro: In Fruit Mania Deluxe, nine independent reels form a 3×3 grid without traditional lines: horizontal or vertical fruit matches pay.
Unlike Fruit Mania from 2014, Deluxe received an updated visual style; Diamond Bonus still awards nine extra spins after the diamond table fills.
wazdan-fruit-mania-deluxe.editorial: This Deluxe version has its own confirmed release on June 20, 2018; sharing RTP of 96.59% and a maximum win of 1000x with the original does not make the two records identical.

features.title: Nine-spin Diamond Bonus
features.description: Filling the diamond matrix awards nine extra spins; this reward does not come from a simple three-fruit combination.

features.title: Lotto Bonus with a box choice
features.description: Three Lotto symbols open a bonus with three concealed gift boxes, one of which is selected for a prize.

features.title: Block Symbols Mode
features.description: The player can hold selected symbols during a spin, increasing the chance of forming a combination on the nine-position grid.

intro: Six Bonus Symbols trigger Hold & Win with locking symbols.
A Mystery Symbol can reveal a jackpot or a Super Symbol leading to Super Bonus.
3-oaks-gaming-sun-of-egypt-3.editorial: In the third instalment, Hold & Win expands through the combination of Mystery and Super Symbols, allowing the bonus to move into Super Bonus.

features.title: Hold & Win and Royal x10000
features.description: Six Bonus Suns trigger Hold & Win with locking symbols; Mystery can reveal Mini, Minor, Major, Grand or a Super Symbol. All fifteen filled positions can award Royal x10000.

features.title: Super Bonus with higher values
features.description: Super Bonus can open from five Bonus Symbols together with one Super Symbol, or when a Super Symbol appears in regular Hold & Win. Sun values are higher in this feature.

features.title: Free Spins with high-paying symbols
features.description: A separate Free Spins mode uses only high-paying symbols and allows extra spins. It should not be confused with Super Bonus.

intro: A Fortuna symbol triggers a Regular, Super or Epic Fortuna Wheel. The wheel selects one of 12 sectors containing adding/multiplying multipliers or jackpot prizes, and the Cash Prize Bar collects all results as a money win.
The bonuses specifically enhance Fortuna Wheels: 3 FS award 10 free spins with a higher chance of wheels, 4 FS leave only Super/Epic versions, and 5 FS guarantee three Fortuna Wheels on every spin.
hacksaw-gaming-rise-of-fortuna.editorial: Rise of Fortuna separates special-symbol appearances from the final calculation: each wheel first forms its own value, and the Cash Prize Bar then combines the results of all active Fortuna Wheels into a single payout.

features.title: Three types of Fortuna Wheels
features.description: A Fortuna symbol triggers a Regular, Super or Epic Wheel with twelve sectors. The wheel reveals an adding multiplier, multiplying multiplier or jackpot prize; multiple landed wheels activate separately.

features.title: Cash Prize Bar and calculation order
features.description: All Fortuna Wheel results combine in the Cash Prize Bar, including money and multiplier values. An individual wheel-sector award does not guarantee the game's overall maximum.

features.title: Wheel of Fortune, Fortunate Fate and Fortune Favours the Bold
features.description: Three FS award ten Free Spins with an increased chance of Fortuna Wheels; four allow only Super or Epic Wheels. Five FS open the highest bonus with three guaranteed Fortuna Wheels on every spin.

intro: Coin symbols carrying values appear on reels 2–4, while the Slay Collector on the outer reels collects all visible Coins and Instant Win symbols. Soul Fire Multiplier symbols on reel 5 increase a persistent multiplier meter by +1; this multiplier applies to collection values but not to payways wins.

Level Up symbols advance a five-level progression system in the base game and Free Spins. Higher levels add double collection events, stacked cash symbols on the centre reels and a guaranteed Instant Win at the highest level; Level Lock during Free Spins can preserve the level reached for a future bonus.
playn-go-cursed-moon-power-collection.editorial: Cursed Moon Power Collection is built around three connected layers: collection, a persistent Soul Fire Multiplier and five-level progression. At the time of review, the official Play’n GO page had not disclosed exact Free Spins trigger details, so Slotfolio does not supply an invented number of Scatters or spins.

features.title: Slay Collector
features.description: A collector on an outer reel collects visible coins and Instant Win symbols.

features.title: Soul Fire Multiplier
features.description: A symbol on the fifth reel increases the persistent collection multiplier by one without affecting regular payways wins.

features.title: Level Up
features.description: Five-stage progression adds double collections, stacked cash and Instant Win; Level Lock can preserve the level.

intro: Fruits Go Bananas takes five reels and five fixed lines onto a cruise-ship deck, where a pineapple substitutes for symbols and doubles wins.
The banana Scatter handles Free Spins: three bananas award 10 spins, four award 20, and five award 30. Alongside the regular pineapple Wild, the game includes Random Wilds.
wazdan-fruits-go-bananas.editorial: The pineapple x2 should not be confused with the overall maximum of 850x: the former doubles only a combination in which it participates, while the latter applies to the whole game.

features.title: Pineapple Wild x2
features.description: Substitutes for regular symbols except Scatters and doubles a winning combination in which it participates.

features.title: Bananas for 10, 20 and 30 spins
features.description: Three, four or five Scatters anywhere trigger 10, 20 or 30 free spins respectively.

features.title: Random Wilds
features.description: Random Wild symbols can be added to the grid independently of the regular pineapple Wild.

intro: Six Bonus, Jackpot or Mystery Symbols trigger Hold & Win with three respins.
Boost collects Bonus Symbol values and can multiply them, while the Sun Meter opens another route to the bonus.
3-oaks-gaming-sun-of-egypt-4.editorial: Sun of Egypt 4 connects Hold & Win with Boost and Bonus Accum: the bonus can be triggered directly by symbols or by filling the meter.

features.title: Boost x3–x5
features.description: The Boost Symbol collects visible Sun Bonus Symbol values and can multiply them by x3, x4 or x5. This feature distinguishes the fourth instalment from its predecessors.

features.title: Hold & Win and Mystery
features.description: Six Bonus, Jackpot or Mystery Symbols award three respins with counter resets. Mystery can become a Bonus, Boost, Super or one of the fixed Jackpot Symbols.

features.title: Bonus Accum and Free Spins
features.description: Every Sun Symbol fills the Sun Meter for an additional entry into Hold & Win. Bonus and Boost Symbols appear more frequently during Free Spins, and the meter remains active.

intro: Ymir acts as a sticky Wild Multiplier: on landing it receives a multiplier, remains in place and triggers a respin. New Ymir extend the chain, while four Ymir on one reel combine into a Giant Ymir with the sum of their values.
The Megamultiplier adds the values of all Ymir on the grid into a global multiplier and triggers a respin itself; new Ymir during subsequent respins increase that global value.
hacksaw-gaming-rise-of-ymir.editorial: Rise of Ymir builds its main progression around sticky Ymir multipliers: every new symbol both extends the respin sequence and can strengthen the overall Megamultiplier. In Fury of Ymir, the activated global multiplier persists between bonus spins.

features.title: Sticky Ymir and Giant Ymir
features.description: A Ymir Wild Multiplier locks at its position and triggers a Respin. New Ymir extend the chain, while four Ymir on one reel combine into a Giant Ymir that sums their multipliers.

features.title: Megamultiplier from all Ymir
features.description: The Megamultiplier symbol collects the values of all existing Ymir on the grid into a global multiplier and triggers a new Respin. Subsequent Ymir can further increase the collected value.

features.title: Ymir’s Conquest and Fury of Ymir
features.description: In the bonuses, Ymir appears more frequently and extends Sticky Respins; Fury of Ymir preserves the activated global Megamultiplier between individual bonus spins instead of resetting it after each one.

intro: Full Reel Wilds always occupy a whole reel. In addition, every regular spin receives its own random win multiplier, so the multiplier changes from spin to spin even before the bonus.

A set of special tour Scatter symbols triggers Progressive Free Spins and randomly awards 5 to 15 spins. The triggering base spin's multiplier carries into the bonus and then continues increasing progressively during Free Spins.
playn-go-dansband-pa-turne.editorial: Dansband På Turné uses a short but clear progression: the base spin randomly sets the starting multiplier, and Free Spins continue increasing it rather than resetting it. Full Reel Wilds work the same way throughout the game and need no separate feature trigger.

features.title: Full Reel Wild
features.description: The Wild occupies a whole reel rather than a single position.

features.title: Random base multiplier
features.description: Each regular spin receives a separate random win multiplier.

features.title: Progressive Free Spins
features.description: Tour Scatters award a random 5–15 spins: the triggering spin's multiplier carries over and then increases.

intro: Gem Splitter uses five reels and 243 ways to win; the Splitter symbol can split a selected symbol and reshape the combination within the same spin.
The provider highlights five possible splitting outcomes, along with Scatter, Free Spins, Wild and Buy Feature. ‘Five ways to split’ should not be treated as the number of ways to win.
wazdan-gem-splitter.editorial: The distinctive element is not simply 243 ways, but a random Symbol Splitter with five outcomes. The stated maximum of 9000x refers to the whole game, not a single symbol split.

features.title: Symbol Splitter with five outcomes
features.description: During a spin, a random symbol splits according to one of five scenarios, changing the available combinations.

features.title: 243 ways
features.description: Combinations pay across 243 ways without a fixed set of traditional lines.

features.title: Free Spins and Buy Feature
features.description: Free spins are available through the in-game Scatter trigger; Wazdan also separately lists a bonus purchase option.

intro: Six Bonus and/or Power Symbols trigger Hold & Win.
The Power Symbol activates Jackpot, Boost or Multi, while collecting symbols gradually opens additional rows.
3-oaks-gaming-sun-of-egypt-5.editorial: The fifth instalment's key mechanic is the Power Symbol: it changes individual bonus positions and works together with grid expansion.

features.title: Power: Jackpot, Boost and Multi
features.description: A Power Symbol in Hold & Win can assign a Jackpot, increase coin values or add a Multiplier up to x10 to several symbols at once. This is a new layer in the fifth instalment.

features.title: Expansion by up to three rows
features.description: Six Bonus or Power Suns activate Hold & Win. Collecting symbols opens up to three additional rows; filling the expanded grid can award the Royal Jackpot worth x5000.

features.title: Sun Meter and Free Spins
features.description: A full Sun Meter triggers the Bonus Game with a guaranteed Power Symbol. Free Spins retain high-paying symbols, with Bonus and Power symbols appearing more frequently.

intro: Normal and Revealing Stackways symbols fill their reel with 2–10 matching symbols if that expansion creates a win. Normal produces stacks of 2–4, while Revealing Stackways produces 5–10 symbols.
Stack Spins award 10 free spins with an increased chance of Stackways, while Super Stack Spins allow only Revealing Stackways, increasing the minimum size of the stacks created.
hacksaw-gaming-ronin-stackways.editorial: Ronin Stackways changes winning-stack height during the spin: the mechanic activates only when expansion actually creates a combination, so Stackways does more than add symbols—it selects the longest available win.

features.title: Normal Stackways and symbol reveal
features.description: Normal Stackways reveals a stack of two to four matching paying symbols on its reel, only if that expansion creates a win. The height directly changes the number of possible combinations.

features.title: Revealing Stackways increases height
features.description: Revealing Stackways creates taller stacks of five to ten symbols. Unlike the regular version, it increases the minimum number of symbols revealed but still requires a winning combination.

features.title: Stack Spins and Super Stack Spins
features.description: Three FS award Stack Spins with more frequent special Stackways Symbols. Four FS trigger Super Stack Spins, in which only Revealing Stackways can appear on the reels, with Normal excluded.

intro: Three or more Pyramid Scatters trigger Free Spins, after which the Wheel of God determines the number of spins, up to 15. On each Free Spin, Ra randomly selects a picture symbol and temporarily upgrades it to a stronger symbol.

During Free Spins, the Pyramid becomes a Wild Pyramid. Two or more Wild Pyramids trigger Pyramid Spins: each reveals a spin count, the values add together, and upgraded picture symbols retain their upgraded state until this sequence ends; 2+ Scatters can retrigger Pyramid Spins without a stated hard limit.
playn-go-dawn-of-egypt.editorial: Dawn of Egypt uses a two-stage bonus system: first the Wheel of God sets the regular Free Spins, then Wild Pyramids can move the game into a more persistent Pyramid Spins mode, where symbol upgrades no longer reset after every spin.

features.title: Wheel of God
features.description: Three or more Pyramid Scatters open Free Spins; the wheel determines the number, up to 15.

features.title: Ra's upgrade
features.description: On each Free Spin, a selected picture symbol is temporarily replaced by a higher-paying one.

features.title: Pyramid Spins
features.description: Two or more Wild Pyramids award a separate sequence in which symbol upgrades persist until its end.

intro: Golden Sphinx is built around twenty lines and two different enhancements: the sphinx Wild substitutes for regular symbols and doubles wins, while the chest Scatter opens free spins.
For the bonus round, Wazdan describes 15 Free Spins with an x3 multiplier on all wins; this is different from the base game's Wild x2.
wazdan-golden-sphinx.editorial: The two multipliers should be distinguished: the sphinx's x2 applies when substituting, while x3 applies during Free Spins. Neither replaces the overall ceiling of 4650x.

features.title: Sphinx Wild x2
features.description: When a Wild helps form a winning combination, that combination pays double.

features.title: Chest Scatter and 15 spins
features.description: The chest can activate a bonus of fifteen free spins.

features.title: Free Spins multiplier x3
features.description: All winning combinations are tripled during the bonus spins.

intro: Six Bonus Symbols trigger Hold & Win with three respins and sticky symbols.
A Mystery Symbol can turn into a jackpot or a Super Symbol, while a full Sun Meter also triggers Hold & Win.
3-oaks-gaming-sunlight-princess.editorial: Sunlight Princess offers two routes to its main bonus: a Bonus Symbol combination or a full Sun Meter.

features.title: Hold & Win from six Suns
features.description: Six Bonus Suns start Hold & Win with three respins. New symbols lock and restore the counter, while Mystery can reveal a jackpot or a Super Symbol.

features.title: Sun Meter and Super Bonus
features.description: Filling the Sun Meter provides an alternative entry into Hold & Win. A Super Symbol can move the game into Super Bonus, where prize-symbol values increase.

features.title: Free Spins and distinct bonuses
features.description: Three Temple Scatters open separate Free Spins; this is not Hold & Win. The mode includes prize Wild symbols, and new Scatters can add spins.

intro: Wild Posters can have up to three Hearts and their own multiplier. While at least one Heart remains, a Poster stays on the grid and triggers a respin; one Heart is lost after each respin.

In Who Shot the Sheriff?, the bonus is divided into Collect and Payout phases: Rusty and Curly expand into sticky Wild Reels, shoot multipliers and carry the collected value into three subsequent payout spins.
hacksaw-gaming-rusty-and-curly.editorial: Rusty & Curly uses Hearts as a Wild Poster's lifespan: more hearts keep the symbol in position longer and provide respins. The higher bonus switches the mechanic to collection and payout cycles with sticky Wild Reels.

features.title: Wild Posters with Hearts
features.description: A Wild Poster holds a multiplier and up to three Hearts. While hearts remain, it holds its cell and triggers another Respin; each repeat consumes one Heart, gradually bringing the sequence to an end.

features.title: Rusty and Curly create Wild Reels
features.description: In the Who Shot the Sheriff? bonus, Rusty and Curly expand into locked Wild reels. They shoot multiplier symbols, which collect on the corresponding reels.

features.title: Collect and Payout Cycles
features.description: The bonus has a separate Collect phase accumulating reel multipliers, and a Payout phase using those multipliers on three subsequent winning spins. This differs from the base Wild Poster's Hearts mechanic.

intro: Rise of Olympus 100 is a separate Play’n GO cluster slot on a 5×5 grid. Winning combinations of three or more matching symbols disappear in cascades, while Hand of God can activate randomly on a non-winning spin.
Wins with god symbols fill a meter and trigger Wrath of Olympus. Clearing the entire grid in this mode opens Free Spins; the bonus allows up to 100 spins and a multiplier up to x100.
playn-go-rise-of-olympus-100.editorial: The powers of Hades, Poseidon and Zeus perform different tasks here. Hand of God is not triggered by filling the meter: it is a random effect on a non-winning turn. The meter triggers Wrath of Olympus, while the separate Clear the Grid reward is calculated as 50 bets with the current multiplier applied, rather than adding x50 to the multiplier.

features.title: 5×5 grid and cascading wins
features.description: Three or more matching symbols form a winning combination vertically or horizontally. Winning symbols disappear, new ones fall from above, and a single paid bet can produce several successive cascades.

features.title: Hand of God and three gods' powers
features.description: Random Hand of God can occur on a non-winning spin. Hades transforms random symbols into a single type; Poseidon adds Wilds; Zeus removes two low-paying symbol types and replaces them. The active god changes during play.

features.title: Wrath of Olympus and Free Spins
features.description: Wins with god symbols charge the meter for Wrath of Olympus: all three powers apply in this mode, and clearing the whole grid can open Free Spins. Depending on the chosen god, the bonus starts with four, five or eight spins; extra spins can be earned, up to 100 in total.

features.title: Clear the Grid and bonus multiplier
features.description: Clearing the regular grid awards a separate prize of 50 bets multiplied by the current multiplier; it does not add x50 to the meter. During Free Spins, the multiplier increases under the bonus rules and is capped at x100.

intro: Good Luck 40 stands out through forty lines on five reels and Middle Eastern symbols, with Wilds and Scatters accompanying regular combinations.
The official page separately lists Free Spins and Risk Game, but the provider does not state the exact free-spin count in its current description.
wazdan-good-luck-40.editorial: The slot has low volatility alongside a stated maximum win of 2000x. A Free Spins count should not be invented: Wazdan confirms the mode but not its duration.

features.title: Forty lines
features.description: The base game uses 5 reels and 40 active lines, rather than 40 line-free ways.

features.title: Wild and Scatter
features.description: The Wild helps form line payouts, while the Scatter participates in activating the bonus mode.

features.title: Free Spins and Gamble
features.description: The provider confirms free spins and a separate post-payout risk round without specifying the spin count.

intro: Green, red and purple Coin Symbols fill Pot Metres and trigger the Bonus Game.
Activated Pots enable Boost, Double and Multi, while the White Pot opens Super Bonus.
3-oaks-gaming-super-china-pots.editorial: Super China Pots centres on the combination of Pot Features: the bonus changes according to the filled colour meters, and the White Pot strengthens the mode.

features.title: Pot Metres
features.description: Coloured Coin Symbols fill meters and open Hold & Win with Boost, Double and Multi features. Different activated meters allow several effects to combine.

features.title: Boost, Double and Multi
features.description: Boost increases random values up to x10 and can upgrade a jackpot tier, Double opens a second bonus grid, and Multi adds multipliers to Bonus Symbols.

features.title: White Pot and Super Bonus
features.description: The new White Pot moves the game into Super Bonus, with increased values and up to three active features. This belongs to Super China Pots, rather than the original 3 China Pots.

intro: A Wild Scarab Multiplier triggers a respin on landing, stays on the grid and applies its multiplier to every payline in which it participates. New Scarabs continue the respin sequence.
During respins, Sandstorm shifts all symbols one reel to the left, while Firestorm increases the multiplier of every Wild Scarab on the grid.
hacksaw-gaming-sand-and-ashes.editorial: Sand and Ashes builds its chain around the movement of existing Wild Scarabs: Sandstorm changes their position relative to paylines, while Firestorm increases their values. In Storming Sphinx, Scarabs become persistent throughout the bonus.

features.title: Wild Scarab and Sticky Respins
features.description: A Wild Scarab acts as a multiplier on participating paylines and stays in place for a re-spin. New Scarabs extend the chain, allowing several enhanced positions to accumulate.

features.title: Sandstorm versus Firestorm
features.description: Sandstorm shifts symbols one reel to the left, changing Wild Scarab positions relative to winning lines. Instead of moving symbols, Firestorm increases the multipliers of all Scarabs on the grid.

features.title: Storming Sphinx and persistent Scarabs
features.description: In the Storming Sphinx bonus, Wild Scarabs can remain in place for the entire set of Free Spins, so their multipliers and positions carry between spins rather than lasting only one Respin sequence.

intro: The Wild Mask appears only on reel 3. If the Mask lands in the centre position, all Dave Hill symbols on the reels turn into Wilds; the Wild Amulet appears on reels 1 and 5.

Wild Amulets simultaneously on reels 1 and 5 together with a Wild Mask on reel 3 trigger One Helluva Night. The bonus awards 6 Free Spins, with a central Mask raising the start to 11; every spin randomly applies an x2, x3, x5 or x8 multiplier.
playn-go-demon.editorial: Demon builds its bonus around the precise geometry of three Wild positions. Within One Helluva Night, two Wild Amulets can open the nested Depths of Hell feature, where the active multiplier carries throughout the nested sequence and can double with a central Mask.

features.title: Wild Mask and Dave Hill
features.description: The Mask appears only on reel 3. If it lands in the middle, Dave Hill symbols on other reels turn into Wilds and can create new winning lines.

features.title: One Helluva Night
features.description: Amulet Wilds on reels 1 and 5 together with a Mask on the third reel trigger six Free Spins, or eleven with a central Mask. Every bonus spin receives a random x2, x3, x5 or x8 multiplier.

features.title: Depths of Hell
features.description: Two Amulets in One Helluva Night open nested Free Spins that preserve the current multiplier. An additional Mask can extend the sequence; a central Mask can double the multiplier once.

intro: Great Book of Magic combines twenty lines with a book Scatter that triggers Free Spins and reveals a special expanding symbol for the bonus spins.
The Expanding Bonus Symbol is selected before the round, so this mechanic is different from a permanent Wild on all regular spins.
wazdan-great-book-of-magic.editorial: The book matters beyond its Scatter role: it provides the transition to a round with an expanding special symbol. The original game's technical record lists a maximum of 5150x.

features.title: Book Scatter
features.description: The special symbol opens free spins; Wazdan also separately lists Scatter.

features.title: Selecting the Expanding Bonus Symbol
features.description: Before the spins, a symbol is selected that can expand across a reel during the bonus.

features.title: Five reels and twenty lines
features.description: Base payouts run along 20 lines, so bonus expansion should not be confused with the line count.
